cover.top: FLORIDA DECLARED A STATE OF EMERGENCY
cover.main: FOR 25 COUNTIES AS ISAIAS IS EXPECTED TO STRENGTHEN

photo.query: dramatic satellite view Gulf of Mexico tropical storm Florida visible
photo.prompt: dramatic satellite view of a tropical storm over the Gulf of Mexico with Florida visible to the east, storm bands clearly defined

slides.headline: Florida declared a state of emergency for 25 counties
slides.body: Gov. Ron DeSantis issued the order Wednesday as Tropical Storm Isaias formed and moved toward Florida.

photo.query: Florida governor hurricane briefing emergency operations center storm map
photo.prompt: Florida emergency briefing room with a governor at a podium, storm track map on large screens, and emergency officials in the background

slides.headline: Isaias formed in the southwestern Gulf
slides.body: Local 10 reported the storm formed early Wednesday in warm water off eastern Mexico.

photo.query: satellite tropical storm Gulf of Mexico bands overhead
photo.prompt: tight overhead satellite-style view of swirling storm bands over dark Gulf water

slides.headline: Forecasters expect it to rapidly strengthen into a hurricane
slides.body: WPTV and The Weather Channel said Isaias is forecast to become a hurricane before it reaches the Gulf Coast.

photo.query: hurricane satellite eye Gulf of Mexico storm bands
photo.prompt: close satellite image of strengthening storm bands curling into a clearer center over the Gulf

slides.headline: Some outlets expect stronger hurricane conditions later this week
slides.body: The Weather Channel described Isaias as a significant Gulf hurricane threat, and ABC7 WWSB said the hurricane threat is growing.

photo.query: Florida coast rain wind waves hurricane preparation
photo.prompt: Florida coastal scene with rough surf, palm trees bent by wind, and a dark rain curtain moving inland

caption:
Florida has 25 counties under a state of emergency as Isaias forms in the Gulf and is forecast to strengthen into a hurricane.
